supplements.title: Deguelin inhibits perineural invasion in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma via targeting BDNF/TrkB axis.
supplements.summary: A natural compound called deguelin blocks nerve invasion in esophageal cancer by targeting a specific growth pathway.

supplements.title: Tumor-suppressing efficacy of essential oil of Boswellia serrata gum resin and its synergistic effect on doxorubicin-induced growth inhibition of breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Boswellia serrata essential oil kills breast cancer cells and boosts doxorubicin effectiveness, suggesting potential as complementary cancer therapy.

supplements.title: Theranekron modulates extracellular matrix and apoptotic signaling pathways in colorectal cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Theranekron extract kills colorectal cancer cells by activating apoptosis and restoring healthy extracellular matrix balance through multiple signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Gut microbe-derived N-acyl serinol lipids shape host postprandial metabolic homeostasis.
supplements.summary: Gut bacteria produce lipids that regulate how the body processes food and manages metabolism after meals.

supplements.title: Probiotics-enhanced kynurenic acid mitigates cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity in mice.
supplements.summary: Probiotics boost kidney-protective compound kynurenic acid, reducing kidney damage from cisplatin chemotherapy in mice.

supplements.title: Anticancer selenopeptides from food sources: synthesis strategies and multitarget mechanisms.
supplements.summary: Selenopeptides from food sources show promise against cancer by combining selenium's protective properties with peptides to trigger cancer cell death through multiple mechanisms.

supplements.title: Drug Interactions in People on Cannabidiol: Is There Cause for Concern?
supplements.summary: Researchers investigated whether cannabidiol oil causes dangerous drug interactions in cancer patients taking multiple medications.

supplements.title: Nanoemulsion in cancer therapy: Enhancing the therapeutic efficacy of capecitabine and 5-fluorouracil in colorectal cancer with thymoquinone nanoemulsion.
supplements.summary: Thymoquinone nanoemulsion boosts colorectal cancer cell death when combined with chemotherapy drugs, potentially allowing lower drug doses.

supplements.title: Identification and Validation of an Inhibitor of the Protein Kinases PIM and DYRK.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified a compound from fermented wheat germ that inhibits PIM and DYRK protein kinases, showing promise against pancreatic cancer cells.

supplements.title: RagC senses β-hydroxybutyrate abundancy to suppress mTORC1 and tumor growth.
supplements.summary: A ketogenic diet compound called β-hydroxybutyrate suppresses colorectal cancer growth by blocking mTORC1 through a protein called RagC.

supplements.title: Finger Citron (Citrus medica L. var. sarcodactylis Swingle) and Its Characteristic Component Limettin Alleviated Diet-Induced Obesity via Modulating Gut Microbiota and Steroid Hormone Biosynthesis.
supplements.summary: Finger citron extract and its compound limettin reduce obesity by reshaping gut bacteria and boosting steroid hormone production.

supplements.title: Cocoa flavanol supplementation and prevention of cardiovascular disease: a novel analysis of the COSMOS randomized trial using 'win ratio'.
supplements.summary: Cocoa flavanol supplements slightly reduced cardiovascular disease risk in healthy older adults when accounting for event severity, though the benefit was modest.

supplements.title: Diet, physical activity, all-cause and cause-specific mortality: repeated measures considerations.
supplements.summary: Better diet and regular exercise together reduce deaths from all causes, heart disease, and diet-related cancers by up to 41%.

supplements.title: An integrative in silico and in vitro approach to target uterine fibroids using natural compounds.
supplements.summary: Three natural plant extracts selectively kill uterine fibroid cells in laboratory tests, offering potential non-surgical treatment for this common condition.

supplements.title: Genetic determinants of lycopene concentration in subcutaneous adipose tissue: insights into interindividual variability in adult males.
supplements.summary: Genetic variants in 11 genes explain about half the differences in how much lycopene men store in fat tissue, potentially affecting prostate and breast cancer risk.

off_label.title: Immunometabolism in lung cancer - The link between metabolism and immune response.
off_label.summary: Lung cancer tumors reprogram their metabolism to suppress immune responses, offering new therapeutic targets to restore anti-tumor immunity.

off_label.title: Metformin in gastrointestinal cancers and inflammatory bowel disease: Unraveling its mechanisms and therapeutic applications.
off_label.summary: Metformin shows promise in treating gastrointestinal cancers like colorectal, esophageal, and gastric cancers through the AMPK/mTOR pathway.

off_label.title: Hypoxia-induced cisplatin resistance in cancer: a comprehensive exploration of molecular mechanisms and novel therapeutic strategies.
off_label.summary: Low oxygen in tumors helps cancer resist cisplatin chemotherapy, but new oxygen-delivery systems and targeted drugs show promise in reversing this resistance.

off_label.title: A Phase I Trial of Riluzole and Sorafenib in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors and Melanoma
off_label.summary: A Phase I trial combines riluzole and sorafenib to find safe doses and effectiveness against advanced solid tumors and melanoma.

off_label.title: Repurposing the SSRI paroxetine increases lymphocyte mobilization and improves the efficacy of measles virus-based immunovirotherapy.
off_label.summary: Adding antidepressant paroxetine to measles virus immunotherapy boosts immune cell mobilization and improves survival in glioblastoma.

off_label.title: Statin use and risk of contralateral breast cancer: an updated cohort study with landmark analysis.
off_label.summary: Statin use after breast cancer diagnosis does not reduce the risk of developing cancer in the other breast.

off_label.title: DHE - past, present, and future: a narrative review.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed new needle-free DHE formulations for migraine relief, with nasal and inhalation options recently approved by the FDA.

off_label.title: Targeting tumor-associated sympathetic nerves orchestrates tertiary lymphoid structures to enhance PD-1/PD-L1 blockade efficacy.
off_label.summary: Blocking sympathetic nerve signals in gastric cancer enhances immune checkpoint therapy by boosting anti-tumor T-cell responses.

off_label.title: Ticagrelor reverses multidrug resistance in breast cancer by inhibiting PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway and suppressing ABCB1 expression and function.
off_label.summary: Ticagrelor, an antiplatelet drug, reverses drug-resistant breast cancer by blocking a key protein that pumps chemotherapy drugs out of tumor cells.

off_label.title: Discovery of Niclosamide Analogs with Potent Mitochondrial Uncoupling Activity and Reduced Mitochondrial Inhibition-Associated Toxicity.
off_label.summary: Researchers modified niclosamide to create safer cancer-fighting drugs that uncouple mitochondria more effectively while reducing toxic side effects.

off_label.title: SGLT2 inhibitors and AMPK crosstalk in diabetes mellitus: mechanistic insights and therapeutic applications.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors treat diabetes by activating AMPK, a protein that protects heart, kidney, and liver function through multiple cellular mechanisms.

off_label.title: Cardiometabolic vulnerability in cardio-oncology: mechanistic links, clinical implications, and emerging preventive strategies.
off_label.summary: Cancer patients with existing heart disease risk factors face higher cardiovascular damage from cancer treatments; new preventive strategies help reduce this risk.

off_label.title: AURKA-mediated destabilization of SAPS3 drives ferroptosis evasion via 7-dehydrocholesterol biosynthesis in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: AURKA protein drives colorectal cancer resistance to ferroptosis by altering cholesterol metabolism, making AURKA inhibition a potential treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Pilot Study of Meclofenamate in Subjects With Recurrent or Progressive Brain Metastasis From Solid Tumor Primary
off_label.summary: Researchers test meclofenamate, a pain medication, to stop brain cancer spread in patients with recurring tumors.

off_label.title: A Phase I Trial of MK-2206 and Hydroxychloroquine in Solid Tumors, Melanoma, Renal and Prostate Cancer to Examine the Role of Autophagy in Tumorigenesis
off_label.summary: A trial testing whether combining two drugs—MK-2206 and hydroxychloroquine—kills advanced melanoma, prostate, and kidney cancer cells better than either drug alone.

biomarkers.title: Immunogenicity of neoantigens from hepatocellular carcinoma patients treated with a combined radioimmunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Hepatocellular carcinoma patients who didn't respond to immunotherapy still harbored immunogenic tumor mutations suitable for personalized neoantigen vaccines.

biomarkers.title: Deguelin inhibits perineural invasion in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma via targeting BDNF/TrkB axis.
biomarkers.summary: A natural compound called deguelin blocks nerve invasion in esophageal cancer by targeting a specific growth pathway.

biomarkers.title: LncRNA Dlx4os drives malignant transformation and phenotype switching in melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: A melanoma gene called Dlx4os drives aggressive cell behavior; blocking it reduces invasion and slows tumor growth in mice.

biomarkers.title: The role of mesencephalic astrocyte-derived neurotrophic factor in digestive diseases.
biomarkers.summary: MANF protein shows promise as a potential treatment target and diagnostic marker for liver, intestinal, and pancreatic diseases.

biomarkers.title: Metabolic characteristic changes in local tissues after high-intensity focused ultrasound treatment for uterine fibroids.
biomarkers.summary: High-intensity focused ultrasound alters the chemical makeup of uterine fibroid tissue, potentially explaining how the treatment works.

biomarkers.title: Histone methyltransferase DOT1L differentially affects the development of dendritic cell subsets.
biomarkers.summary: DOT1L epigenetic regulator controls dendritic cell development differently across immune cell subtypes, suppressing antigen presentation pathways.

biomarkers.title: Stage-specific transcriptomics of a leader cell reveals cell machineries driving collective invasion.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified molecular machinery enabling leader cells to invade tissue and guide collective cell migration, with potential cancer metastasis applications.

biomarkers.title: Tumor-suppressing efficacy of essential oil of Boswellia serrata gum resin and its synergistic effect on doxorubicin-induced growth inhibition of breast cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: Boswellia serrata essential oil kills breast cancer cells and boosts doxorubicin effectiveness, suggesting potential as complementary cancer therapy.

biomarkers.title: Theranekron modulates extracellular matrix and apoptotic signaling pathways in colorectal cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: Theranekron extract kills colorectal cancer cells by activating apoptosis and restoring healthy extracellular matrix balance through multiple signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Tim-3-targeted vaccines overcome tumor immunosuppression and reduce cDC1 dependence to elicit potent anti-tumor immunity.
biomarkers.summary: Tim-3-targeted vaccines activate immune cells to fight tumors effectively, even without specialized dendritic cells normally required for cancer immunity.

biomarkers.title: Gut microbe-derived N-acyl serinol lipids shape host postprandial metabolic homeostasis.
biomarkers.summary: Gut bacteria produce lipids that regulate how the body processes food and manages metabolism after meals.

biomarkers.title: Regulation of the immune CD155-CD226-TIGIT axis by cyclin D-CDK4/6.
biomarkers.summary: CDK4/6 inhibitors boost breast cancer immune response by increasing CD155 and reducing TIGIT, suggesting combining them with anti-TIGIT antibodies enhances treatment.

biomarkers.title: Targeted NMR signal enhancement of RNA by site-directed bis-nitroxide labeling.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new labeling technique that dramatically boosts NMR signal strength for studying cancer-linked microRNA-34a interactions with target mRNAs.

biomarkers.title: A transcription regulator atlas identifies TOX3 as an Atoh1 coactivator in cerebellar development and tumorigenesis.
biomarkers.summary: TOX3 protein acts as a critical helper for Atoh1 in cerebellar development and medulloblastoma, with its removal reducing brain tumor growth in mice.

biomarkers.title: A systematic review of observational studies on long-term air pollution exposure and epigenetic alterations in adults.
biomarkers.summary: Long-term air pollution exposure may cause lasting epigenetic changes in adults, potentially affecting health outcomes.

trials.title: Immunogenicity of neoantigens from hepatocellular carcinoma patients treated with a combined radioimmunotherapy.
trials.summary: Hepatocellular carcinoma patients who didn't respond to immunotherapy still harbored immunogenic tumor mutations suitable for personalized neoantigen vaccines.

trials.title: Tim-3-targeted vaccines overcome tumor immunosuppression and reduce cDC1 dependence to elicit potent anti-tumor immunity.
trials.summary: Tim-3-targeted vaccines activate immune cells to fight tumors effectively, even without specialized dendritic cells normally required for cancer immunity.

trials.title: Regulation of the immune CD155-CD226-TIGIT axis by cyclin D-CDK4/6.
trials.summary: CDK4/6 inhibitors boost breast cancer immune response by increasing CD155 and reducing TIGIT, suggesting combining them with anti-TIGIT antibodies enhances treatment.

trials.title: Multi-omics analysis reveals features improving outcomes and immunotherapy resistance in MSS colorectal cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers identified a machine learning signature predicting prognosis and immunotherapy response in colorectal cancer, highlighting CADM1's role in tumor progression.

trials.title: CMV seropositivity associates with poor clinical outcome in triple negative breast cancer.
trials.summary: CMV infection is associated with worse survival outcomes in triple-negative breast cancer patients and alters immune cell distribution.

trials.title: Cisplatin-incorporating gelatin-coated gadolinium oxide nanoparticles for cancer theranostics.
trials.summary: Nanoparticles combining cisplatin and gadolinium oxide enable both cancer imaging and drug delivery with controlled release in tumors.

trials.title: Functional characterization of BAP1 mutations in genome edited cholangiocarcinoma organoids: Role in cell death and drug responses.
trials.summary: BAP1 mutations in bile duct cancer reduce cell death but increase sensitivity to sorafenib, suggesting a biomarker for personalized treatment.

trials.title: Targeting peptidyl-arginine deiminase 4 suppresses SARS-CoV-2 replication and modulates the inflammatory response.
trials.summary: Blocking PAD4 enzyme reduces SARS-CoV-2 replication and inflammation, offering a potential COVID-19 treatment strategy.

trials.title: Cost-effectiveness of first-line encorafenib plus cetuximab with mFOLFOX6 in BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer.
trials.summary: Encorafenib plus cetuximab improves survival in BRAF-mutant colorectal cancer but costs too much to be considered cost-effective treatment.

trials.title: MSMO1 promotes chemotherapy resistance through modulation of T-MAS metabolism via PERK/elF2α/ATF4/CHOP pathway.
trials.summary: MSMO1 protein promotes breast cancer chemotherapy resistance by altering cholesterol metabolism, identifiable through a blood test for personalized treatment.

trials.title: Differential fates of Kazald gene quartet: Ancestral roles in skeletogenesis and regeneration to putative innovations in fish and birds.
trials.summary: Researchers identified a four-member Kazald gene family in vertebrates, tracing its evolutionary origins and revealing conserved roles in skeleton development and regeneration across species.

trials.title: Placing purines in precision medicine: Targeting a metabolic reliance in KRAS-mutant tumors.
trials.summary: Combining a MEK inhibitor with a purine analog overcomes drug resistance and improves survival in KRAS-mutant cancers.

trials.title: Five-Year Clinical Outcomes With Nivolumab Plus Ipilimumab Versus Chemotherapy as First-Line Treatment for Unresectable Pleural Mesothelioma in CheckMate 743.
trials.summary: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab improved five-year survival in pleural mesothelioma compared to chemotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Multi-cohort and single-cell profiling of aging genes reveals prognostic and therapeutic targets in breast cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers developed an eight-gene aging signature to predict breast cancer survival risk and identify patients who may benefit from immunotherapy.

trials.title: Effect of direct mailing self-sampling kits on participation in the Dutch hrHPV-based cervical screening programme: a population-based study.
trials.summary: Mailing self-sampling kits to women increased participation in Dutch cervical cancer screening programs.
